summary: Iteration 106 regression on BRUNO global search (privacy/pagination/fuzzy/handle/suggest/trending/history/ask/admin reindex/status), admin moderation lookup + timeline, and lives delegated moderators. Backend: 30/30 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration106_search_mod_lives.py (JUnit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter106.xml, 17.5s). Covered: GET /api/search accent/case ('DISEÑADOR' == 'disenador' same total), fuzzy 'cansion' → fuzzy_terms+'Canción antigua del río Magdalena', '@viewer' people hits ≥1, '#bruno' hashtag group, old 2026-01-05 post findable, pagination type=posts&limit=2 no duplicates across pages with has_more flag, sort=newest/oldest both return items, q>100 → 400, invalid type → 400. PRIVACY: private card 'Tarjeta Secreta Zanahoria' NOT returned to owner newtest (OK — only public cards indexed), viewer4 private-account post 'Xilófono privado' hidden from newtest BUT visible to viewer4 themself, type=ai anonymous → total 0, viewer2 and newtest AI conversations isolated (no overlap). AUX: /search/suggest ≤8 items, /trending OK, /history CRUD (populate → disable=clears → re-enable), POST /search/ask returned answer+sources+generated:true in <45s, /search/admin/reindex 403 for normal / 200 for admin testc, /search/status returns indexed count. ADMIN MOD: /admin/users/lookup?q=viewer → 403 normal / 200 admin with ≥1 row; /admin/users/{uid}/moderation-timeline on b1838f61-… → 403 normal / 200 admin with user+events+strikes+reports_received and each event has at/action/by. LIVES DELEGATED MODS: host testb creates+starts live, viewer2+viewer4 join; host add_mod viewer2 → response moderators + moderators_info[] contains name; GET /lives/{id} as viewer2 returns is_moderator=true; viewer2 (as mod) can mute viewer4 (200) but add_mod → 403 (host-only); host remove_mod viewer2 → moderators now empty; cleanup end live. FRONTEND @390x844 and 1920x800: MobileBottomNav order left→right confirmed Reels·Tienda·Mapa·Crear·Buscar·Notificaciones·Perfil (via data-testid x-coords), labels NOT clipped at 390px (screenshot), nav-notifications-badge visible with numeric text='2', nav-search navigates to /search, nav-create opens publish menu (verified by code path iter105). /search page: input placeholder 'Busca en BRUNO' ✓, search-home + search-history-toggle + search-filter-all/.../search-filter-ai + search-back all present; typing 'disenador' renders search-group-* groups (2 groups); 'cansion' shows search-fuzzy-hint; 'zzzzqqq' shows search-empty with 'Buscar en todo' chips. Clicking a card result opened /c/{id} and browser back preserved input ('disenador' intact) — sessionStorage restore works. 'Preguntar a BRUNO IA' (search-ask-btn) rendered search-ask-answer with source chips within 45s. Admin UI (testc): /admin/reports has admin-reports-history-link → /admin/users shows admin-mod-user-search → /admin/users/b1838f61…/moderation shows admin-mod-timeline with mod-event-0 'Live detenido · sobre live «Live infractor» · por Prueba C · Motivo: QA'. STRIPE E2E (Connect onboarding + ticket 4242) NOT exercised end-to-end — see action_items; backend endpoints exist (money.py connect/onboard, connect/status, checkout kind=ticket) and were covered previously in test_money.py (24/24 PASS last iter). Full external Stripe hosted onboarding + Checkout redirect flow is outside sub-agent scope (requires live Stripe test session with form filling + webhook settlement).

ui_bugs.issue: Non-admin users (newtest) see the full 'Historial de moderación' UI shell (search input + title) instead of 'Solo administración' denial message. Backend correctly returns 403 on data endpoints, so no data leaks — but UX requirement from task was explicit denial screen for non-admins.

action_items: FRONTEND: On /admin/users and /admin/users/:id/moderation routes, render a 'Solo administración' guard when current user role != admin (currently the page shell is reachable; data stays private via 403 but UX diverges from spec).

STRIPE E2E (manual, out of sub-agent scope): main agent should manually walk through newtest@bruno.com → /earnings → 'Completar datos' (earnings-continue-onboarding) → Stripe hosted test onboarding → return to /earnings?connect=return → GET /api/money/connect/status should show charges_enabled or reduced requirements_due. Then create a paid live via POST /api/lives (host newtest) with ticket_price field, start it, and from viewer2 /lives/{id} click buy ticket → Stripe Checkout 4242 4242 4242 4242 / 12/40 / 123 / 12345 → verify GET /api/money/lives/{id}/ticket.has_ticket=true and host /earnings 'Detalle por operación'. Report exact blocking step if transfers are not enabled on the Connect account.
critical_code_review_comments: compliance.py line 464: '{"id": e["by"], "name": m.get("name") if m else ("Sistema" if not e.get("by") else "Admin")} if (e.get("by") or True) else None' — the ternary 'if (e.get("by") or True) else None' is always True, so the None branch is dead code; simplify to always assign the dict. Minor readability.

search.py /ask uses model 'gpt-5.4-mini' — ensure this model id remains supported by the Emergent LLM integration layer; if the integrations fallback silently to a different model, the 'generated:true' contract still holds but logs should surface the actual model used.
search.py /history returns a bare list vs other endpoints returning {items:...}; keep API shape consistent OR document in frontend (useSearch.js already handles both — fine but inconsistent).

Admin UI (/admin/users*): add a frontend role-guard HOC/wrapper that redirects non-admins or renders 'Solo administración' to match product spec and reduce surface for scraping admin UI (even without data access).
lives.py moderate_live: response includes moderators_info[] — ensure name fallback for banned/deleted mods doesn't leak PII (observed name present for live viewer2, acceptable).

success_rate.frontend: 95% — nav + search page + admin timeline all verified; one UX gap on /admin/users guard for non-admin; Stripe Connect E2E not run.

For UI, data-testid vocabulary for search is stable (search-input, search-home, search-history-toggle, search-filter-{all,videos,publications,people,businesses,cards,hashtags,store,comments,ai}, search-group-*, search-group-more-*, search-fuzzy-hint, search-empty, search-ask-btn, search-ask-answer, search-back, search-clear). Bottom nav testids (nav-reels, nav-marketplace, nav-map, nav-create, nav-search, nav-notifications, nav-notifications-badge, nav-profile) order verified at 390 and 1920. Admin: admin-reports-history-link, admin-mod-user-search, admin-mod-timeline, mod-event-N. The private-card privacy rule is 'only public cards are indexed as discoverable' — do not add private cards to discoverable list, even for owners (owner sees via /c/:id, not search). Stripe Connect onboarding and ticket purchase remain to be verified manually by main agent in test mode.
rca_of_the_issue: Minor UX divergence on /admin/users for non-admins: the page component mounts and renders its chrome before the role check gates rendering of the data; expectation per spec was a 'Solo administración' screen. Impact: no data leak (backend returns 403) but non-admins can see the admin UI shell. Fix: wrap the AdminUserLookupPage/AdminUserModerationPage in a role-based guard that early-returns the 'Solo administración' element when current_user.role !== 'admin'.
